blocked.explain: Schedule 3 line 8 is blocked because line 1 is blocked or another Part I credit absence authority is incomplete.

closure_backed_zero.explain: A current derived finding publishes zero through honest closed-empty or zero-credit authority on the direct-election path.

computed_zero.explain: A current derived finding publishes a computed zero.

guard_inapplicable.explain: No value is published because a scope, election, threshold, or creditability component is not satisfied for the bounded class.

published_value.explain: Schedule 3 line 8 equals line 1 under explicit absence of other Part I credits; carries to Form 1040 line 20.
